title: Dr. Pong Clinic — Website
content: Dr. Pong Clinic is a leading dermatology and aesthetic skincare clinic based in Bangkok, Thailand. We specialise in evidence-based skincare treatments including acne therapy, anti-aging procedures, skin brightening, and personalised skincare regimens. Our team of certified dermatologists combines medical expertise with the latest cosmetic technology to help patients achieve healthy, glowing skin. We serve clients across Thailand and offer online consultations. Our products include our signature Dr. Pong Serum line and UV protection range. We believe in transparent, science-backed skincare — no gimmicks, only results.
